import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    
    n = int(input[0])
    a = list(map(int, input[1:n+1]))
    r1, c1, r2, c2 = map(int, input[n+1:])
    
    # Calculate the minimum number of key presses
    moves = abs(r2 - r1)
    if r1 == r2:
        moves += abs(c2 - c1)
    else:
        moves += min(c1, a[r1-1] + 1) - 1 + c2
    
    print(moves)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
